description: This bar chart illustrates the number of samples categorized by different types of reasoning tasks, with the vertical axis representing the "Number of Samples" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^2 to 10^4, and the horizontal axis listing the reasoning categories in the order: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. Each bar is light blue and labeled with its exact count: Mathematical Reasoning has 1709 samples, General Reasoning has 1709 samples, Natural Scene Reasoning has 413 samples, Physical Reasoning has 232 samples, Logical Puzzle Reasoning has 91 samples, and Chemical Reasoning has 49 samples. The bars are arranged in descending order of sample count from left to right, with Mathematical Reasoning being the tallest bar and Chemical Reasoning the shortest. There is no visual emphasis or annotation beyond the numerical labels on top of each bar.
